ab.note: A decorative divider line follows the inscription.
The correction was surely intended to be to υπερ, but no there is no indication that the iota was deleted.
The first hand uses shorthand for the -ην ending, and the correction writes it out explicitly.
The corrector simply expands the abbreviation.
The correction above the line of text is rewritten in the right margin for clarity.
Again, the corrector merely expands the shorthand.
The circular stain above this word may contain a correction because ink appears to be present.
Αn enlarged π to make προ was probably intended but not completed.
The most likely place for the addition of οιτινες is here, but since it is written in the margin with no corresponding marking in the text, it could have been placed anywhere on the line.
